name: Minecraft Java Edition
description: The original Minecraft Java Edition dedicated server. Supports vanilla, Paper, Spigot, Forge, Fabric, and many more server types via the EULA-compliant itzg/minecraft-server Docker image. Includes automatic server JAR download and update management.
author: Arc Panel

defaultEnv.MOTD: A Minecraft Server powered by Arc Panel

envVariableDefinitions.name: Accept EULA
envVariableDefinitions.description: Must be TRUE to agree to Minecraft's End User License Agreement.

envVariableDefinitions.name: Server Type
envVariableDefinitions.description: The type of Minecraft server to run.

envVariableDefinitions.name: Minecraft Version
envVariableDefinitions.description: The Minecraft version to use. Use LATEST for the most recent stable release.

envVariableDefinitions.name: JVM Memory
envVariableDefinitions.description: Memory allocated to the JVM heap (e.g., 1G, 2G, 4G). This should be less than the container memory limit.

envVariableDefinitions.name: Max Players
envVariableDefinitions.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server.

envVariableDefinitions.name: Default Game Mode
envVariableDefinitions.description: Default game mode for new players.

envVariableDefinitions.name: Online Mode
envVariableDefinitions.description: Enable to require players authenticate with Mojang. Disable for offline/cracked servers.
